newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenyan tea prices firm at weekly auction.
newsitem.headline: Kenyan tea prices firm at weekly auction.

text.p: Kenyan tea prices were firmer at the weekly export auction in Mombasa on Monday, boosted by strong demand, auction officials said.

Brighter BP1s gained 20-24 U.S. cents while Lower mediums edged 2-3 cents. Brighter PF1s went up 10-20 cents while Lower medium PF1s gained 5-8 cents. Brighter DUST1s were a little dearer while mediums tended easier.
Fannings and Dusts were dearer on quality. Pakistan was very strong while Egypt was less forceful.
